'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 647
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>One of the sailors in Port Sarim is your next destination.
|notes = Speak to [[Captain Tobias]] in [[Port Sarim]].
|map = {{Map|3026,3216|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Charter ship]] to [[Port Sarim]].
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in [[Rimmington]], or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the Rimmington [[house portal]].
*[[Ring of the elements]] teleport to the [[Air Altar]].
*[[Spirit tree patch]] in Port Sarim.
*[[Explorer's ring]] 2, 3, or 4 teleport to [[Falador farm]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Draynor Village]] and run west.
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|aiq}} and run north.
*[[Falador Teleport]] and run south to Port Sarim.
